statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds CVE-2026-82078 or CVE-2026-81578 with a date_added value between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains an entry for CVE-2026-82078 or CVE-2026-81578 carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-16 inclusive.
failure_condition: Neither PaperCut CVE carries a KEV dateAdded value inside that window when the catalog is fetched on 2026-10-20.

statement: Stolen City of Berlin administrative data is published on an extortion leak site between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of BBC, Reuters, dpa, Tagesspiegel or Heise report that data taken from Berlin city systems was published by the extortion group in that window.
failure_condition: No publication of Berlin municipal data by the extortionists is reported by two of the named outlets by 2026-11-04.

statement: At the scheduled 2026-09-16 FOMC decision the Committee raises the federal funds target range to 3.75 to 4.00 percent.
resolution: TRUE if the FRED series DFEDTARU shows 4.00 for 2026-09-17, matching a 25 basis point increase announced in the 2026-09-16 FOMC statement.
failure_condition: The upper bound of the target range holds at 3.75 percent or moves to any value other than 4.00 percent after the 2026-09-16 decision.

statement: Front-month ICE Brent crude settles at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if ICE publishes a front-month Brent futures settlement price of 100.00 USD or higher for any trading day inside that window.
failure_condition: Every front-month Brent settlement in the window prints below 100.00 USD per barrel.

statement: A petition for a writ of certiorari arising from the 2026-08-28 Ninth Circuit prediction-market ruling is docketed at the US Supreme Court between 2026-08-29 and 2027-02-13.
resolution: TRUE if the Supreme Court electronic docket lists a certiorari petition naming Kalshi and Nevada gaming regulators, docketed on or before 2027-02-13.
failure_condition: No such certiorari petition appears on the Supreme Court docket on or before 2027-02-13.

statement: The UK government announces activation of Operation Safeguard or a new prison early release measure between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if a gov.uk press release or written ministerial statement dated in that window announces Operation Safeguard activation, Operation Early Dawn, or a new early release scheme.
failure_condition: No gov.uk publication dated in the window announces any of those prison capacity measures.

statement: A single Russian strike on Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast kills at least 15 people between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-10.
resolution: TRUE if Ukrainian officials state at least 15 killed in one strike inside that window and two of Reuters, AP, AFP or BBC carry that figure.
failure_condition: The deadliest single Kyiv-area strike in the window is credited with fewer than 15 deaths.

statement: The Ukrainian Air Force reports at least 500 Russian drones and missiles launched in one overnight attack between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if a Ukrainian Air Force overnight air-situation report covering a night inside that window states a combined launch total of 500 or more munitions.
failure_condition: Every Ukrainian Air Force overnight tally in the window stays below 500 combined drones and missiles.

statement: The confirmed death toll in Nepal from the 2026-08-26 Rasuwa flood reaches at least 1000 between 2026-08-30 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if Nepal Police or the NDRRMA give a confirmed Nepal death toll of 1000 or more inside that window, carried by two of Reuters, AP, AFP or BBC.
failure_condition: The official Nepal death toll stays below 1000 through 2026-10-31.

statement: The CFTC announces a new enforcement action over misuse of nonpublic information in event contracts between 2026-09-01 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if a CFTC press release dated inside that window announces a case alleging trading of event contracts on material nonpublic information.
failure_condition: No CFTC press release dated in the window announces such an event-contract insider trading case.
